tasks.question: How does the mixin class that adds input/output methods to N-dimensional data containers ensure extensibility of the centralized file format registry without breaking existing subclasses of the base data container when new format handlers are registered?
tasks.reference_answer: NDIOMixin installs UnifiedReadWriteMethod descriptors for NDDataRead and NDDataWrite, whose calls delegate to the registry at runtime (astropy/nddata/mixins/ndio.py:56-114). The registry chooses the nearest registered ancestor using the MRO (astropy/io/registry/base.py:329-345). The property-based descriptor prevents instance attributes shadowing the interface (interface.py:147-155). New registrations therefore need not modify the mixin, but arbitrary replacement of existing handlers is not guaranteed to preserve behavior.

tasks.question: What semantic constraints does the unit mapping specification field in the representation-to-frame attribute mapping tuple impose on astronomical coordinate system conversions when set to the null value versus the automatic unit inference string?
tasks.reference_answer: RepresentationMapping.defaultunit=None requests no unit mapping; "recommended" keeps inferred defaults, degrees for Angle subclasses and None otherwise (astropy/coordinates/baseframe.py:126-136,1081-1109). In represent_as with in_frame_units=True, only truthy target units cause .to(new_attr_unit) conversion (1379-1384). This controls representation component units and is not a guarantee that arbitrary frame transformations preserve all input units.

tasks.question: What is the semantic relationship between the expiration threshold computed in the test initialization method and the early-exit optimization tested across multiple test methods?
tasks.reference_answer: The test computes a good_enough date to match normal-config production selection and checks that selected files outlive it (astropy/utils/iers/tests/test_leap_second.py:230-234,322-329). Production computes today plus 180 minus auto_max_age days, using 30 when auto_max_age is None (iers.py:1158-1159), and stops searching when the best candidate expires after that threshold (1194-1198). The system-file test skips when its fixture fails this future-validity condition. The threshold is stricter than merely being unexpired today, and the formulas should not be described as identical for every configuration.
